findings.highlight: "Rrgh...! What it this!? It can touch Tohsaka, so why can't I...!?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「っ……！　なんだこれ、遠坂には触れるのに、どうして……！」
findings.governingReading: Shirou can touch Rin although he cannot remove her mud covering; 俺 understood from the voiced attempt and lifted Rin at page3.
findings.explanation: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.

findings.highlight: "Rrgh...! What it this!? It can touch Tohsaka, so why can't I...!?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「っ……！　なんだこれ、遠坂には触れるのに、どうして……！」
findings.governingReading: The exclamation asks what this is.

findings.highlight: So if we can just talk, she'll go back to—
findings.evidenceJa: こうして、ちゃんと俺と話をして、いつも通り—
findings.governingReading: Shirou tries to maintain that Sakura is unchanged: she is thus talking properly to him as usual, before her refusal interrupts.
findings.explanation: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.

findings.highlight: I haven't been swallowed by this titanic magical energy yet.
findings.evidenceJa: その膨大すぎる魔力に呑まれた訳じゃない。
findings.governingReading: His paralysis is not because he was overwhelmed by her enormous magical energy; the next sentences identify her intent to kill him as its cause.
findings.explanation: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.

findings.highlight: That's why I needed to disappear in front of you."
findings.evidenceJa: だからわたし、先輩の前から消えないといけなかった」
findings.governingReading: 先輩の前から消える is to disappear from his presence/leave him, because being together burdens him; the source departure and following inability to relinquish him establish sense.
findings.explanation: Disappear from his life becomes disappear in front of him.

findings.highlight: I don't even try to evade it.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が避ける事は考えつけなかった。
findings.governingReading: He did not think of himself evading, while his thoughts are in pieces.
findings.explanation: Failure even to conceive of evasion becomes merely not trying.

findings.highlight: Sakura shrouds the entire yard in darkness. She isn't holding back anymore, after Rider's betrayal.
findings.evidenceJa: ……ライダーの裏切りで本気になったのか、桜から広がる影は中庭を覆い尽くす。
findings.governingReading: The shadow covers the courtyard; the narrator conjectures that Rider's betrayal may have made Sakura become serious.
findings.explanation: The English states that Sakura is no longer holding back where the Japanese presents that as an explanation the narrator is considering. Both versions call Rider's action a betrayal.

findings.highlight: "Exactly what I said. You can consume Rider, kill Shirou, and neutralize Rin, but it's pointless to you right now. You're just wasting time, so why don't you stop the temper tantrum already?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「言葉通りの意味よ。ライダーを取り込んでもシロウを殺してもリンを再起不能にしても、今のサクラには意味がないってコト。時間の無駄だし、八つ当たりはそのあたりにしておいたら？」
findings.governingReading: 再起不能 specifies making Rin unable to recover/get back up, alongside killing Shirou and absorbing Rider.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.

findings.highlight: But my dress isn't here. If you want to open the gate as a successor, you'll need to take me to my castle."
findings.evidenceJa: けど正装はここにはないの。サクラが後継者として門を開きたいんなら、わたしの城まで取りに行かないと」
findings.governingReading: Ceremonial/formal dress isn't here; if Sakura wants to open the gate as successor, they must go to Illya's castle to fetch it.
findings.explanation: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.

findings.highlight: "And you've settled your scores, haven't you?
findings.evidenceJa: 「それに、サクラは決着をつけるコトにしたんでしょう？
findings.governingReading: 決着をつけるコトにした says Sakura has decided to bring the matter to a conclusion.
findings.explanation: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.

findings.highlight: You let that part of you in because you didn't want to kill anyone else, but now you're saying you have to kill them all. You're contradicting yourself, Sakura."
findings.evidenceJa: 誰も殺したくないから受け入れたのに、今はもうみんなを殺したくて仕方がないなんて、矛盾してるわよサクラ」
findings.governingReading: 今はもうみんなを殺したくて仕方がない is now wanting to kill everyone so badly she can't help it, contradicting her earlier choice to avoid killing.
findings.explanation: Irresistible desire to kill everyone becomes claimed necessity to kill them.

findings.highlight: It's my duty to take care of the rest. Sakura's going to take me away, so you can rest now."
findings.evidenceJa: 後の始末はわたしの役目だもん。サクラはわたしが連れて行くから、シロウはもう休んでいいよ」
findings.governingReading: Illya says she will take Sakura away, identifying herself as the agent.
findings.explanation: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.

findings.highlight: I chase after them with reckless abandon, pushing through the nausea, the chill, and my soup-like brain.
findings.evidenceJa: 全身鉛、吐き気と悪寒で脳みそがぐるんぐるんの状態で、遠ざかっていく二人を追いかける。
findings.governingReading: His whole body feels like lead, and nausea/chills make his brain spin, as he chases the girls.
findings.explanation: Lead-heavy whole-body impairment disappears during renewed pursuit.
